translations.web: But he said, “As Yahweh lives, before whom I stand, I will receive none.” He urged him to take it; but he refused.
translations.bsb: But Elisha replied, “As surely as the LORD lives, before whom I stand, I will not accept it.” And although Naaman urged him to accept it, he refused.
translations.kjv: But he said, As the LORD liveth, before whom I stand, I will receive none. And he urged him to take it; but he refused.
translations.asv: But he said, As Jehovah liveth, before whom I stand, I will receive none. And he urged him to take it; but he refused.
